description: Na₃GdCl₆ is Corundum-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Cl¹⁻ atoms to form distorted NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent GdCl₆ octahedra, edges with six NaCl₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one GdCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 55°. There are three shorter (2.74 Å) and three longer (2.94 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Cl¹⁻ atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GdCl₆ octahedra and edges with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 41°. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.79 Å. Gd³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Cl¹⁻ atoms to form GdCl₆ octahedra that share corners with twelve NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-55°. All Gd-Cl bond lengths are 2.68 Å. Cl¹⁻ is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Gd³⁺ atom.
